card.name: Inside drug names before the ending
card.fires_on: A syllable in the middle of a drug name, just before the final ending (remdes-iv-ir, carvedil-ol, mel-oxic-am, nap-rox-en). It is strongest on the 'iv' in remdesivir in dilution and dosing text.

modes.label: Remdesivir 'iv'
modes.description: The 'iv' piece inside remdesivir in preparation and dilution instructions.
modes.example: each vial contains 100 mg/20 mL (5 mg/mL) of remdes<<iv>>ir solution.

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: A middle or late piece of another drug name, such as carvedilol, meloxicam, naproxen or betamethasone.
modes.example: the recommended oral dose of mel<<oxic>>am is 7.5 mg once

modes.label: Non-drug name
modes.description: Occasionally a piece of a proper name outside drug text.
modes.example: Brahma is the Creator, Vish<<nu>> the Preserver
